task_name: README Quick start and Releasing runbook

concerns_addressed: Prior T8 verdict (cycle 1, REVIEW_PASS at 19a54ea) preserved: its Stage 1 concerns (step 4 version bump, stub line replacement, 'may expire' wording) are untouched by a1dc69d.

P2-F2: runbook now has step 5 moving v0 (git tag -f v0 vX.Y.Z; git push -f origin v0) after step 4 pushes the semver tag. Correct position and correct mechanism: release.yml only triggers on exact semver tags (v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+*) and publishes npm only, so the floating v0 tag is not moved by any automation.

Intro: the exact legacy sentence is kept (asserted by readme.test.ts:179) and a second sentence clarifies that the v0 major tag must also move (step 5). Combined text is accurate enough for maintainers but slightly tension-laden: 'one tag releases ... together' is literally true only for npm, and the clarifier corrects it.

Scope: diff touches only README.md (inside ## Releasing) and action/readme.test.ts; no yaml block with rfxlamia/ce@ added before ## GitHub Action. Step numbering 1-6 consistent, step reference '(step 5)' is correct, former step 5 renumbered to 6.

strengths: Fix is minimal and targeted: two prose edits, one sh-fenced command block, one test.
Test guards the two load-bearing commands, so removing the v0 move step fails the suite while the legacy intro assertion still passes.
sh fence (not yaml) preserves the existing no-rfxlamia/ce@-before-Action-section invariant.

issues.description: Step 5 does not say to move v0 only after the release workflow (release.yml) succeeds. If the npm publish fails (tag/version mismatch, expired trusted publisher), v0 would already point at an unpublished release for Action users. Advisory: add 'after the Release workflow run for the tag succeeds'. Not blocking: the Action does not depend on the npm publish at the tag, and the runbook already stresses the workflow can fail.

Step 5 uses vX.Y.Z without noting that prerelease tags (e.g. v0.2.0-rc.1, which the following paragraph says are supported) must not move v0. A maintainer following the steps for an rc could move the stable major tag to a prerelease.

Intro still opens with 'Pushing one tag releases the GitHub Action and the npm package together', immediately qualified by the next sentence; the test pins the legacy wording, so rewording is deferred. New test is substring-only and does not assert ordering after the semver-tag step.

strategies: Added v0 major-tag move step to the Releasing runbook (P2-F2)
